answer: Audits are entered in jetty, queued in fable, and crystal publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 45 identities per epoch. A farm of 194 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 1765 identities would post 1168 proofs and burn roughly 62 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
